issues.explanation: In 带刘备、关羽、张飞, 带 means “to lead/take along,” not “band.”
关羽 is a personal name and must remain one name segment.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge into one name segment: 关羽

issues.explanation: In 令他率本部, 率 is pronounced shuài, not lǜ.
In 令他率本部, 率 means “to lead/command,” not the bound-form noun “ratio.”
埋伏 is pronounced mái fú; the first syllable is second tone.
In 山左右, 山 means “mountain,” not the surname Shan.
The dictionary-reference gloss is not useful in context and points to modern 青州市; here 青州 is the historical place/prefecture.
斩杀 here means killing, possibly by beheading; glossing it only as “to behead” is too narrow.
